question:
(i) Explain the relation between charge stored and potential difference for a capacitor and define capacitance.
(ii) For a given capacitor, the potential difference increases from $40\text{ V}$ to $100\text{ V}$ when an additional charge of $18\,\mu\text{C}$ is supplied to it. Find the capacitance of the capacitor and the charge initially stored on it.

options.C:
(i) $Q=CV$, so $C=\frac{Q}{V}$; capacitance is the charge stored per unit potential difference.
(ii) $C=\frac{\Delta Q}{\Delta V}=0.3\,\mu\text{F}$ and $Q_i=CV_i=12\,\mu\text{C}$
